quote.quote: On April 14, 2020, since the Applicant formally withdrew these claims, FDA announced that the Medical Imaging Drugs Advisory Committee meeting that had been scheduled for April 23, 2020, was cancelled because the issues for which FDA was seeking the scientific input of the Committee had been resolved.

no_adcom_quote.quote: The Advisory Committee meeting was cancelled, and the following Federal Registry Notification posted on April 13, 2020:

summary: FDA had scheduled a Medical Imaging Drugs Advisory Committee meeting for April 23, 2020 to obtain scientific input on Tauvid (flortaucipir F 18, NDA 212123), but the meeting was cancelled after the Applicant formally withdrew the claims at issue on April 14, 2020, resolving the questions FDA intended to pose. Because no advisory committee meeting was held, there was no committee vote or recommendation, and no committee-raised concerns can be tied to changes in the approval. Labeling changes made at approval (e.g., the CTE-misdiagnosis Limitation of Use and Warnings and Precautions) were negotiated between FDA and the Applicant during review rather than driven by an advisory committee.
